intro.text: The leader of one of the three gangs inside Elantris, whose followers are known for their savage brutality.
A young girl who leads one of the three gangs in Elantris, worshipped by her crazed followers for her golden hair. Raoden recognizes her as Soine, Duke Telrii's daughter.

items.text: Worried by mounting raids from Shaor's gang, Raoden and Galladon went to its base in an old bank to talk. They were surprised to find a young girl in charge, and had to run when she ordered her followers to attack.

Raoden knew her as Soine, the daughter Duke Telrii said had died of dionia. She was bald and had worn a golden wig, which the priests left on when she was cast into Elantris, thinking it was her own hair. Her maddened followers worshipped her for that hair.
Once Raoden's people took in the newcomers whose food Shaor's men had been seizing, the gang killed her and brought her wig to Raoden as a sign that they now followed him.
